name: Samy Sandoval and Sandra Sandoval
description: '''Samy and Sandra Sandoval''' are a brother-and-sister [[musical duo]] from [[Panama]]. They perform ''[[típico]]'', a form of traditional [[Music of Panama|Panamanian music]] and Panamanian-style ''[[cumbia]]''. They have been praised as ''patrónes de la cumbia'' (masters of cumbia), and are very popular in Panama.
